questions.question: Which of these does NOT affect how far it takes to stop your vehicle?

options.text: Steering ability
Braking distance
Reaction distance
Perception time

questions.correctAnswerText: Steering ability
questions.explanation: Your stopping distance depends on perception time, reaction distance, and braking distance. These change based on your speed and road conditions.

questions.question: A flashing red traffic light means the same thing as a:

options.text: Solid red light.
Stop sign.
Yield sign.
Caution sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must stop completely. You may go only when it is safe. A stop sign may also be posted at this location.

questions.question: If an accident causes an injury, a death, or $1,000 or more in property damage, you must report it to police within ____ of the accident.

options.text: Two days
Four days
Five days
10 days

questions.correctAnswerText: Four days
questions.explanation: If an accident causes an injury, death, or $1,000 or more in property damage, you must file a Collision Report form within four days of the accident.

questions.question: You are driving a slow vehicle in a no passing zone on a two-lane road. When should you pull over to let others pass?

options.text: When one vehicle is behind you.
When two or more vehicles form a line behind you and it's unsafe for them to pass.
When five or more vehicles form a line behind you and it's unsafe for them to pass.
When the road has slow-moving vehicle signs.

questions.correctAnswerText: When five or more vehicles form a line behind you and it's unsafe for them to pass.
questions.explanation: If you are driving slowly on a two-lane road where passing is unsafe and five or more vehicles are lined up behind you, you must pull over and stop to let them pass, if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: A slow-moving vehicle emblem is a:

options.text: Rectangular red sign.
Circular green sign.
Diamond-shaped yellow sign.
Triangular orange sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Triangular orange sign.
questions.explanation: The slow-moving vehicle emblem is a reflective orange triangle. Vehicles with this emblem are traveling at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a certain number of passengers.
Certain turns are allowed from certain lanes.
Do not enter.
Both lanes must merge safely together.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a certain number of passengers.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. HOV lanes are for buses and cars with a driver and at least one passenger, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What is the best way to stay safe when backing your vehicle?

options.text: Honk your horn right before shifting into reverse.
Check behind the vehicle before you sit down to drive.
Look at your rearview mirrors to see what is behind you.
Turn up the radio to alert people around you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check behind the vehicle before you sit down to drive.
questions.explanation: Backing is dangerous because drivers cannot see well behind their vehicles. Before you get in to back up, walk around the back of your vehicle to check for children and small objects.

questions.question: You cannot park within:

options.text: 10 feet of a fire hydrant.
15 feet of a fire hydrant.
20 feet of a fire hydrant.
30 feet of a fire hydrant.

questions.correctAnswerText: 15 feet of a fire hydrant.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to park within 15 feet of a fire hydrant.

questions.question: Pennant-shaped signs show:

options.text: School zones.
No passing zones.
Speed limits.
Railroad crossings.

questions.correctAnswerText: No passing zones.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs mark no passing zones. The sign will have text to confirm it is a no passing zone.

questions.question: Pentagonal signs show:

options.text: No passing zones.
School zones.
Speed limits.
Railroad crossings.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zones.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs indicate a school zone. Be very alert for children and pedestrians when driving near a school.

questions.question: When driving to an unfamiliar area, what should you do?

options.text: Rely on road signs to find your way.
Plan your trip before you start driving.
You only need to know roughly where you are going.
Always take the most direct route.

questions.correctAnswerText: Plan your trip before you start driving.
questions.explanation: Always plan your trip in advance before driving to an unfamiliar area. Do not start driving without knowing where you are going. Check the location on a map before you leave.

questions.question: Why is it important to watch for motorcycles?

options.text: They are harder to see than cars.
They rarely use their headlights.
Motorcyclists are less skilled than other drivers.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are harder to see than cars.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are smaller and harder to see than cars. They can hide in your blind spot. It is hard to judge how far away a motorcycle is and how fast it is going. Always be alert and careful around motorcycles.

questions.question: An oncoming driver does not dim their bright headlights. Where should you look?

options.text: At the wheels of the oncoming vehicle.
Toward the right side of the road.
Toward the left side of the road.
Straight ahead down the center of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Toward the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road when oncoming headlights are too bright. This keeps you from being blinded and lets you see the road well enough to stay on course until the other vehicle passes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Bicycles crossing ahead.
Stop.
Fines are doubled in work zones.
Stop ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Bicycles crossing ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns drivers that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to road work.
Slow down because the road ahead curves sharply.
There is a side road to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead curves sharply.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead has a sharp curve or turn. Slow down as if you are turning at an intersection before you reach this curve.

questions.question: Regulatory signs are usually ____ and must always be obeyed.

options.text: White
Blue
Green
Orange

questions.correctAnswerText: White
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are usually white with black markings. They control traffic movement and drivers must always obey them.

questions.question: An oncoming vehicle is heading toward you in your lane. What should you do?

options.text: Honk, steer right, and speed up.
Honk, steer left, and brake.
Honk, steer right, and brake.
Stay in your lane, honk, and brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Honk, steer right, and brake.
questions.explanation: Honk to get the other driver's attention. If they do not move, steer to the right. Do not steer left because the other driver might correct and you will still crash. Brake firmly if a crash is unavoidable. Every mile per hour slower reduces the impact.

questions.question: Two vehicles enter an intersection at the same time from different roads. Which vehicle must yield?

options.text: Either one
The vehicle on the left
The vehicle on the right
Neither

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle on the left
questions.explanation: When two vehicles enter an intersection at the same time, the driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right. This applies at all intersections, whether controlled by signs or signals.

questions.question: Drivers turning left in an intersection:

options.text: Can wait in the intersection until they can turn left.
Can wait in the intersection until the light turns yellow.
Must wait for a green left arrow before turning.
Must not enter the intersection unless they can drive through without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must not enter the intersection unless they can drive through without stopping.
questions.explanation: Never enter an intersection unless you can drive all the way through without stopping. When turning left, wait for oncoming traffic and pedestrians to clear so you do not block the intersection when the light turns red.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a steady yellow arrow on a traffic signal?

options.text: Merge into the lane in the direction of the arrow.
Slow down and stop if it is safe.
Turn left after yielding to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
You have the right-of-way and oncoming traffic will stop for you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and stop if it is safe.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow arrow means a red arrow is about to appear. Stop your vehicle unless you are already in the intersection.

questions.question: What is a speed limit?

options.text: The highest or lowest legal speed you can drive on a road when conditions are dangerous.
The highest or lowest legal speed you can drive on a road when conditions are ideal.
The recommended speed to drive on a road when conditions are ideal.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest or lowest legal speed you can drive on a road when conditions are ideal.
questions.explanation: A speed limit is the highest or lowest legal speed you can drive on a road when conditions are ideal. You can drive slower than the posted limit, but you cannot drive faster. You must drive slower in school zones and work zones. If weather or road conditions make the posted speed unsafe, drive slower than the limit.

questions.question: Which of the following does NOT help with safe night driving?

options.text: Keep your windshield clean.
Know that tinted windows make it harder to see in the dark.
Carry a flashlight in your vehicle.
Look directly into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look directly into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.
questions.explanation: When you look into oncoming headlights, your eyes shrink to adjust to the bright light. After the vehicle passes, your eyes need time to readjust to the darker light. During this time, you cannot see well and are essentially driving blind.

questions.question: When can you cross solid yellow lines?

options.text: To pass other traffic moving in the same direction.
Only during daylight hours.
Anytime.
When making turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: When making turns.
questions.explanation: Broken lines can be crossed, but solid lines cannot. You can only cross solid yellow lines when you are making a turn.

questions.question: You are driving in the left lane and want to move to the right lane. What should you do?

options.text: Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your left shoulder before changing lanes.
Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
Check your mirrors, signal, and look over both shoulders before changing lanes.
Check your mirrors, signal, and change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: When changing lanes, look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move to check your blind spot. Always check your mirrors and turn on your signal before you change lanes.

questions.question: What does a solid red arrow in a traffic signal mean?

options.text: It is never used as a traffic signal.
It means the same thing as a circular red traffic light.
It means drivers can turn in the direction the arrow points.
It means traffic in that direction must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a circular red traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a circular red light. When you see a red arrow, you must stop. You cannot turn in the direction the arrow points.
